features.name: Stop a reply partway

how: While your agent is working, press Stop, or send a message that says only stop.
limits: Stopping does not undo what is already done, such as a row written or a draft made.
Typing cancel does not stop it.
On a shared agent, only the owner's stop stops it.
features.phone: Archie Mobile has a Stop button too, and a message that says only stop works from a chat app.

features.wording: Changed your mind while your agent is working? Type stop, or press Stop, in Archie or in Archie Mobile. What it already finished stays done, and nothing more happens.

Chat apps have no button. Typing /new there does the same thing.

features.name: Archie Mobile
features.summary: Archie Mobile, for iPhone and Android, reaches the agent on your computer, which locks every message with a key that only your phone also holds.
features.where: On an agent's Setup tab, under Chat app, the Archie Mobile row has the link to get it and the code that connects it.
how: Install Archie Mobile from the App Store on iPhone, or from the Android download.
In Archie, open an agent's Setup tab and choose Chat app.
On the Archie Mobile row, press Show the code.
In Archie Mobile, press Scan and point the camera at the code.
limits: Your agent runs on your computer, so it has to be on, awake and running Archie for the phone to reach it.
It does most of what you do at the computer. Signing in to an account still happens at the computer.
We hold the locked messages and cannot read them. We can see when one was left, which Archie version wrote it, and whether a command is done.
Whoever holds the phone holds the key. Disconnect every phone, under the code in Archie, cuts a lost phone off.
features.phone: On iPhone from the App Store, and on Android as a download from a file rather than a store; the Android version is older, so newer features reach iPhone first.
trust: ✅ Archie on your phone: an encrypted mailbox we hold and cannot read (SHIPPED)
✅ The Archie app for a phone: sealed, where a chat app is not. SHIPPED ON ANDROID AND IPHONE
features.wording: The app is not running your agent. Nothing about your agent moves to your phone: it stays on the computer you installed it on, with your files, your passwords and your connected accounts, and it runs there whether your phone is in your hand, in your pocket, or flat. The app is a way to reach that computer and tell it things. What you can do from it is most of what you do at the computer: start it or stop it, add an add-on or take one off, finish an add-on's setup, turn a routine on and off or move the time it runs, rename it, change its face, read what it has been doing, and talk to it.
